newsitem.title: FINLAND: N.RENKAAT SAYS TARGETS GOOD 97 PROFITS.
newsitem.headline: N.RENKAAT SAYS TARGETS GOOD 97 PROFITS.

text.p: Finnish tyres manufacturer Nokian Renkaat Oy said on Thursday it sees better market prospects for 1997 than in 1996 and would target growth and good profitability this year.
"The objective of the company is to continue its growth and to preserve the good profitability level of previous years," Nokian Renkaat said in a statement with its 1996 earnings report.
"The market prospects for the year to come are more positive than those of last year despite continuing price competition," it said.
"The economic outlook for the tyre market in 1997 seems to be better than in 1996," Nokian Renkaat said.
"A slow recovery is expected in the heavy tyres area, as the amount of transportation increases and the outlook for the forest industry improves," it said.
Raw materials prices are likely to remain stable, it said.
"The new products that will enter the market in 1997 are expected to improve both the competitiveness and the position of the company in the market," it said.
